header.label: Construction safety
header.title: Open Safety Studio
header.desc: Open source software for safety plans in construction: health and safety plan, BLVC plan, risk matrix and safe maintenance, with the legal basis always alongside.

why.title: Why Open Safety Studio?
why.desc: Safety on the construction site is not a luxury but an obligation. A health and safety plan or a BLVC plan is often still put together in separate Word files and spreadsheets, again and again.
why.desc2: Open Safety Studio lists the parts the law asks for, shows which article applies to each topic and turns it into a report. Free and open source.

modules.title: Five modules
modules.desc: Each module is its own tab in the app, with the legal framework in the sidebar.
modules.vg: Health and safety plan Following Dutch Arbobesluit art. 2.28: project details, parties involved, phases, special risks from Annex II, asbestos, hazardous substances, emergency procedures and workplace layout.
modules.blvc: BLVC plan Accessibility, liveability, safety and communication around the site, with phasing, traffic measures and communication.
modules.matrix: Risk matrix Assess risks by likelihood and severity in a 5×5 matrix and see at once which have the highest priority.
modules.maintenance: Safe maintenance Building information, permanent provisions and a checklist following Bouwbesluit art. 6.53 and Arbobesluit art. 2.30.
modules.ifc: IFC Import and export IFC models, view their structure and statistics and validate the model.

templates.title: Templates
templates.desc: Start a plan from a template instead of a blank document.

legal.title: Legal basis in view
legal.desc: Next to each part you see which article applies and when a plan is mandatory.

hierarchy.title: Hierarchy of measures
hierarchy.desc: Measures in the order the law sets: the source first, then shielding and restrictions, personal protective equipment last.

report.title: Report
report.desc: Turn the plan into a report to print or share.
